text.formatted: The dragon makes three Rend attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Paralyzing Breath.
text.plain: The dragon makes three Rend attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Paralyzing Breath.

text.formatted: _Melee Attack Roll:_ +10, reach 10 ft. _Hit:_ 15 (2d8 + 6) Slashing damage.
text.plain: Melee Attack Roll: +10, reach 10 ft. Hit: 15 (2d8 + 6) Slashing damage.

text.formatted: _Constitution Saving Throw:_ DC 17, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. _Failure:_ 49 (11d8) Cold damage. _Success:_ Half damage.
text.plain: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 17, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. Failure: 49 (11d8) Cold damage. Success: Half damage.

text.formatted: _Constitution Saving Throw:_ DC 17, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. _First Failure:_ The target has the Incapacitated condition until the end of its next turn, when it repeats the save. _Second Failure:_ The target has the Paralyzed condition, and it repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically.
